title: A quieter museum evening

walkthroughIntro.inOneLine: Generate independently, combine overlapping ideas without erasing differences, then rank candidates against explicit priorities.
walkthroughIntro.bestFor: A team that needs several options before selecting a practical priority.

lenses.name: Generate independent ideas
lenses.instruction: Offer two different ways to address the opportunity. Explain the mechanism in one sentence each. At this stage, avoid rating another person's idea.

lenses.name: Combine and make candidates testable
lenses.instruction: Choose a shared idea or combine compatible ones. Give the candidate a clear label, the outcome it seeks and a small first trial. Keep meaningfully different ideas separate.

lenses.name: Rank against explicit priorities
lenses.instruction: Rank your top two candidates. Explain the expected benefit, effort and main uncertainty for each. Say which criterion matters most and what would change your ranking.

## Decision
Choose Quiet route for one evening: a printed route card gives visitors control with about two hours of preparation. Calm arrival may reduce queues but requires booking setup and has uncertain effects on walk-ins, so it ranks second on effort. Ask which spaces visitors avoided. If entrance queues dominate feedback rather than noisy rooms, prioritize Calm arrival next.
